metadata.coverage_note: This map shows facilities with recent TPCHD results indicating closure or restricted operation, required reinspection, compliance order, scheduled follow-up, or an inspection with 35 or more red points. metadata.data_universe: TPCHD Accela food-facility inspection records observed by this publication run with parsed PDF reports and facility inspection-history pages; this public evergreen layer is one mapped point per facility.
metadata.freshness_note: Generated from the latest TPCHD inspection data publication run. The public map typically updates once a week.

metadata.map_cannot_show: This map does not include TPCHD source records not yet collected in the inspection data store.
